## 💡 Feature Request

### Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Use Case
Describe the use case(s) for this feature.

### Mockups / Examples
If applicable, add mockups, wireframes, or examples of similar features from other products.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criteria 1
- [ ] Criteria 2
- [ ] Criteria 3

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.

### Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and the roadmap
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals
- [ ] I have provided clear acceptance criteria
